minor_findings.summary: Unicode typography differs without changing meaning.
minor_findings.evidence: The candidate uses an en dash instead of the original em dash in the title and ASCII 6 instead of full-width ６ in two Japanese-adjacent count strings.

rationale: The multilingual metadata, ingredient quantities, bain-marie and oven requirements, infusion and bake timing, all completion criteria, caramelization, and final crème brûlée are semantically complete. Only typographic Unicode variants differ.
